Generated media goes through the kit's tools, as REMIX.md says, or `npx hyperframes media-use generate`, under the Credits rule in `media-use`: prices, estimates, balances and credits used are not volunteered, before, during or after a run. A limit the person names is written to `.hyperframes/credit-limit.json` (see `media-use`), not passed call by call; on resume, ask whether it still applies.
